control_point: Real-time public reports of swap transactions are disseminated within the CFTC Part 43 deadline with correct block and cap treatment.

citations.source_name: 17 CFR Part 43 - Real-Time Public Reporting of Swap Transaction Data
17 CFR Part 45 - Swap Data Recordkeeping and Reporting Requirements

consequence_anchor.public_source: CFTC swap-data reporting enforcement under 17 CFR Parts 43, 45 and 46; CFTC civil monetary penalties for reporting violations
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: published CFTC civil monetary penalties ranging from hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of dollars for systematic swap-reporting failures

commonality_rationale: Every swap dealer and major swap participant subject to CFTC regulation must report swaps in real time under Part 43, including correct application of block-trade and cap-size deferrals; the obligation applies across interest-rate, credit, equity, foreign-exchange and commodity asset classes.
